title: Build it: real tools, approval, traces, evals
purpose: Ship a workflow agent with real tools, human approval, traces, evals and a deploy.
why: The applied-AI skill in miniature: a workflow agent that uses real tools, asks before risky actions, and can prove whether it worked.

tasks.title: Uses 3+ real tools/APIs to gather context and act
tasks.done_when: Each tool call is visible in the code and the demo.

tasks.title: Requires human approval for risky actions
tasks.done_when: A risky action waits for a person to approve it.

tasks.title: Logs traces of every run
tasks.done_when: You can open one run and see each step and tool call.

tasks.title: Evaluates success and failure on a small test set
tasks.done_when: 5–10 cases with expected outcomes, run and scored.

tasks.title: Deployed somewhere a person can use it
tasks.done_when: A URL or install a user can open today.
